portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Recent data shows firm inflation (September CPI +0.6% m/m, PPI +1.3% m/m) driven heavily by a 5.2% monthly surge in energy prices, alongside a 10-year Treasury yield around 5.09% and a recent Fed rate hike to 3.75%-4.00%. This rate pressure triggered a sharp factor rotation out of technology and growth (68 of 75 S&P tech constituents fell on Oct 16; RSP beat SPY by 2.46% over 5 days) into energy and defensive value. However, secular leaders with dominant medium-term relative strength (Taiwan, Cybersecurity, Broad AI Tech) have suffered acute short-term pullbacks without company-specific fundamental deterioration, creating high-quality reversal setups ahead of key macro releases.
